question: Which of the following actors was honoured with the 2025 International Goya Award for his contributions to global cinema?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Richard Gere**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Richard Gere** was awarded the International Goya Award in 2025 for his outstanding contributions to global cinema.
 
• The Goya Awards, often referred to as the Spanish Oscars, are presented annually by the Spanish Academy of Cinematic Art and Sciences.
 
• Richard Gere has had a celebrated career spanning decades, starring in critically acclaimed films like **Pretty Woman**, **An Officer and a Gentleman**, and **Chicago**.
 
• He has also been recognized for his humanitarian work, including advocacy for human rights, environmental conservation, and Tibetan causes.
 
• The International Goya Award is granted to individuals who significantly impact cinema worldwide, aligning with Gere's global influence and legacy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Goya Awards Overview:**

 
 
• Established in 1987, the Goya Awards celebrate excellence in Spanish cinema.
 
• They are organized by the Spanish Academy of Cinematic Art and Sciences.
 
• The ceremony includes categories such as Best Film, Best Director, and Best Actor.
 
• International awards recognize contributions to cinema beyond Spanish borders.
 
 
 
• **Richard Gere's Humanitarian Work:**
 
 
• Gere is a prominent advocate for Tibetan independence and a supporter of the Dalai Lama.
 
• He is involved in various charities, including HIV/AIDS awareness and environmental protection.
 
• He founded the Gere Foundation to support humanitarian causes globally.
 
 
 
• **Global Impact of Cinema:**
 
 
• Cinema serves as a powerful medium to influence culture, society, and global awareness.
 
• International awards like the Goya recognize the transnational impact of film and its creators.
 
• Richard Gere’s career exemplifies how cinema can bridge cultural divides and inspire audiences worldwide.
 
 
 
• **Other Recipients of the International Goya Award:**
 
 
• Past recipients include internationally acclaimed actors and filmmakers such as Meryl Streep and Pedro Almodóvar.
 
• The award honors individuals who elevate cinema to a global art form.
